dashboard.community.board.caution.descri: A rating comes with a deviation: how unsure the board still is of it. A cautious board takes some of that doubt off before ranking, so a player it is sure of sits above one it is not.

dashboard.community.board.minimum.descri: A player appears on the board once they have played this many of its rated tournaments. One lists everybody. A higher number keeps a player off until there is more to go on.

dashboard.community.board.option.cautiou: A rating has to be well proven before it climbs. A busy regular outranks a newcomer or a returning player with a similar rating.

dashboard.community.board.option.none.ef: Players are ranked on their rating alone. A newcomer with two strong results can sit at the top before anyone is sure of them.
